                        color='white' if val > 10 else 'black')

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    cbar.set_label('Rate per 100,000')

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_notable_changes(overall):
    """Chart: Countries with largest increases and decreases in homicide rates."""
    # Find countries with at least 15 years of data and compare first vs last 5-year average
    country_counts = overall.groupby('iso_code')['year'].nunique()
    valid_countries = country_counts[country_counts >= 10].index

    changes = []
    for iso in valid_countries:
        cdata = overall[(overall['iso_code'] == iso)].sort_values('year')
        if len(cdata) < 10:
            continue
        early = cdata[cdata['year'] <= cdata['year'].min() + 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        late = cdata[cdata['year'] >= cdata['year'].max() - 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        if early > 0:
            pct_change = ((late - early) / early) * 100
            abs_change = late - early
            changes.append({
                'country': cdata['country'].iloc[0],
                'iso_code': iso,
                'early_rate': early,
                'late_rate': late,
                'pct_change': pct_change,
                'abs_change': abs_change,
            })

    changes_df = pd.DataFrame(changes).dropna()

    # Top 10 improvers (biggest decrease)
    improvers = changes_df.nsmallest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change', ascending=False)
    # Top 10 deteriorators (biggest increase)
    deteriorators = changes_df.nlargest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change')

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    ax1.barh(range(len(improvers)), improvers['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['success'], edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(improvers)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(improvers['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax1.set_title('Largest Decreases (Improvements)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['success'])
    for i, v in enumerate(improvers['pct_change'].values):
        ax1.text(v - 2, i, f'{v:.0f}%', va='center', ha='right', fontsize=7, color='white')

    ax2.barh(range(len(deteriorators)), deteriorators['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['danger'], edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(deteriorators)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(deteriorators['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax2.set_title('Largest Increases (Deteriorations)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['danger'])
    for i, v in enumerate(deteriorators['pct_change'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 2, i, f'+{v:.0f}%', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig), deteriorators, improvers

def build_region_map():

def load_data():

# ─── KPI Computation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def compute_kpis(df):
    """Compute all required KPIs."""
    kpis = {}

    overall = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

    # 1. Global Median Homicide Rate (most recent year with sufficient data)
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent_data = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year]
    kpis['global_median_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].median(), 2)
    kpis['global_mean_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].mean(), 2)
    kpis['most_recent_year'] = int(recent_year)

    # 2. Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio
    male_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'male') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    female_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    # Most recent year with both male and female data
    common_years = set(male_data['year'].unique()) & set(female_data['year'].unique())
    latest_common = max(common_years)
    m_recent = male_data[male_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    f_recent = female_data[female_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    if f_recent > 0:
        kpis['male_female_ratio'] = round(m_recent / f_recent, 1)
    else:

    # 3. Highest National Homicide Rate (most recent year)

    # 4. Decade-over-Decade Change
    decades = {

        '2000s': (2000, 2009),

        '2020s': (2020, 2023),
    }
    decade_avgs = {}
    for label, (start, end) in decades.items():
        period = overall[(overall['year'] >= start) & (overall['year'] <= end)]

        else:
            decade_avgs[label] = np.nan
    kpis['decade_avgs'] = decade_avgs

    year_coverage = {}
    all_years = sorted(overall['year'].unique())

        year_coverage[int(y)] = round(n_reporting / total_countries * 100, 1)
    kpis['year_coverage'] = year_coverage

def fig_to_b64(fig):
    """Convert matplotlib figure to base64 PNG string."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    buf.seek(0)
    b64 = base64.b64encode(buf.read()).decode('utf-8')
    plt.close(fig)
    return f'data:image/png;base64,{b64}'

def chart_global_trend(overall, kpis):

def chart_sex_disparity(df):
    """Chart showing male vs female homicide rates over time."""
    sex_data = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    yearly = sex_data.groupby(['year', 'sex'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    # Left: male vs female trend
    for sex, color, marker in [('male', PALETTE['blue'], 'o'), ('female', PALETTE['accent'], 's')]:
        sdata = yearly[yearly['sex'] == sex]
        ax1.plot(sdata['year'], sdata['homicide_rate'], color=color, linewidth=2,
                 label=sex.capitalize(), marker=marker, markersize=3)

    ax1.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax1.set_ylabel('Mean Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax1.set_title('Male vs. Female Homicide Rates Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.legend()
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # Right: male-to-female ratio over time
    pivot = yearly.pivot(index='year', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate')
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['ratio'])

    ax2.fill_between(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], alpha=0.2, color=PALETTE['gold'])
    ax2.plot(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], color=PALETTE['gold'], linewidth=2.5, marker='D', markersize=3)
    ax2.axhline(y=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Parity (1:1)')
    ax2.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Male-to-Female Ratio')
    ax2.set_title('Gender Disparity Ratio Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax2.legend()
    ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_sex_disparity_by_country(df):
    """Chart: Male-to-female ratio for selected countries (most recent year)."""
    recent = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    recent_year = recent['year'].max()
    recent = recent[recent['year'] == recent_year]

    pivot = recent.pivot_table(index='country', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate', aggfunc='mean')
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['male', 'female'])
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot[pivot['ratio'].notna() & (pivot['ratio'] > 0)]

    # Top 15 countries by ratio
    top15 = pivot.nlargest(15, 'ratio').sort_values('ratio')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    colors = [PALETTE['accent'] if r > 15 else PALETTE['gold'] for r in top15['ratio']]
    ax.barh(range(len(top15)), top15['ratio'], color=colors, edgecolor='white')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(top15)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(top15.index.values, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio')
    ax.set_title(f'Gender Disparity by Country ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    ax.axvline(x=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

    for i, v in enumerate(top15['ratio'].values):
        ax.text(v + 0.3, i, f'{v:.1f}x', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_age_heatmap(df):
    """Heatmap: age group rates by region."""
    age_data = df[(df['age_group'] != 'ALL') & (df['sex'] == 'both')].copy()
    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']

    pivot = age_data.groupby(['region', 'age_group'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()
    heatmap = pivot.pivot(index='region', columns='age_group', values='homicide_rate')

    # Reorder columns and rows
    available_cols = [c for c in age_order if c in heatmap.columns]
    heatmap = heatmap[available_cols]
    heatmap = heatmap.reindex(['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']).dropna(how='all')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
    im = ax.imshow(heatmap.values, aspect='auto', cmap='YlOrRd')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(available_cols)))
    ax.set_xticklabels([age_labels[age_order.index(c)] if c in age_order else c for c in available_cols],
                       fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap.index)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap.index, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Mean Homicide Rate by Age Group and Region', fontweight='bold')

    for i in range(len(heatmap.index)):
        for j in range(len(available_cols)):
            val = heatmap.iloc[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                ax.text(j, i, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
                        color='white' if val > 10 else 'black')

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    cbar.set_label('Rate per 100,000')

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_notable_changes(overall):
    """Chart: Countries with largest increases and decreases in homicide rates."""
    # Find countries with at least 15 years of data and compare first vs last 5-year average
    country_counts = overall.groupby('iso_code')['year'].nunique()
    valid_countries = country_counts[country_counts >= 10].index

    changes = []
    for iso in valid_countries:
        cdata = overall[(overall['iso_code'] == iso)].sort_values('year')
        if len(cdata) < 10:
            continue
        early = cdata[cdata['year'] <= cdata['year'].min() + 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        late = cdata[cdata['year'] >= cdata['year'].max() - 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        if early > 0:
            pct_change = ((late - early) / early) * 100
            abs_change = late - early
            changes.append({
                'country': cdata['country'].iloc[0],
                'iso_code': iso,
                'early_rate': early,
                'late_rate': late,
                'pct_change': pct_change,
                'abs_change': abs_change,
            })

    changes_df = pd.DataFrame(changes).dropna()

    # Top 10 improvers (biggest decrease)
    improvers = changes_df.nsmallest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change', ascending=False)
    # Top 10 deteriorators (biggest increase)
    deteriorators = changes_df.nlargest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change')

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    ax1.barh(range(len(improvers)), improvers['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['success'], edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(improvers)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(improvers['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax1.set_title('Largest Decreases (Improvements)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['success'])
    for i, v in enumerate(improvers['pct_change'].values):
        ax1.text(v - 2, i, f'{v:.0f}%', va='center', ha='right', fontsize=7, color='white')

    ax2.barh(range(len(deteriorators)), deteriorators['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['danger'], edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(deteriorators)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(deteriorators['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax2.set_title('Largest Increases (Deteriorations)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['danger'])
    for i, v in enumerate(deteriorators['pct_change'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 2, i, f'+{v:.0f}%', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig), deteriorators, improvers

def chart_regional_boxplot(overall):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Intentional Homicide Trends Report Generator (1990-2023)
Generates a self-contained HTML report with embedded charts from UNODC data.
"""

import base64
import io
import json
import os
import textwrap
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pycountry

# ─── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DATA_PATH = '/app/benchmark/data.csv'
OUTPUT_PATH = '/app/output/final_report.html'
TASK_INPUT_PATH = '/app/benchmark/task_input.json'

# Color palette — professional, accessible
PALETTE = {
    'primary': '#1B2A4A',       # dark navy
    'accent': '#E85D3F',        # warm red-orange
    'blue': '#3A7CA5',
    'teal': '#2D9B8C',
    'gold': '#D4A843',
    'gray': '#6B7280',
    'light_bg': '#F8F9FA',
    'white': '#FFFFFF',
    'dark': '#1F2937',
    'danger': '#DC2626',
    'success': '#16A34A',
    'warning': '#F59E0B',
}

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Sans'
plt.rcParams['axes.titlesize'] = 12
plt.rcParams['axes.labelsize'] = 10

# ─── Region Mapping ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_region_map():
    """Map ISO alpha-3 codes to UN regions."""
    region_map = {}
    for country in pycountry.countries:
        try:
            iso3 = country.alpha_3
            region_map[iso3] = getattr(country, 'region', 'Unknown')
            if hasattr(country, 'subregion'):
                region_map[f"{iso3}_sub"] = country.subregion
        except AttributeError:
            pass

    # Subregion to broad region mapping
    subregion_to_broad = {
        'Northern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Western Europe': 'Europe',
        'Southern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Eastern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Western Asia': 'Asia',
        'Central Asia': 'Asia',
        'Eastern Asia': 'Asia',
        'Southern Asia': 'Asia',
        'South-eastern Asia': 'Asia',
        'Northern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Western Africa': 'Africa',
        'Middle Africa': 'Africa',
        'Eastern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Southern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Northern America': 'Americas',
        'Central America': 'Americas',
        'South America': 'Americas',
        'Caribbean': 'Americas',
        'Australia and New Zealand': 'Oceania',
        'Melanesia': 'Oceania',
        'Micronesia': 'Oceania',
        'Polynesia': 'Oceania',
    }

    def _get_broad_region(iso3):
        """Get broad region for an ISO alpha-3 code."""
        sub = region_map.get(f"{iso3}_sub", None)
        if sub and sub in subregion_to_broad:
            return subregion_to_broad[sub]
        reg = region_map.get(iso3, None)
        if reg and reg in subregion_to_broad:
            return subregion_to_broad[reg]
        return region_map.get(iso3, 'Unknown')

    # Manual overrides for territories and special cases
    overrides = {
        'HKG': 'Asia', 'MAC': 'Asia', 'TWN': 'Asia',
        'PRI': 'Americas', 'GUM': 'Oceania', 'VIR': 'Americas',
        'CUW': 'Americas', 'ABW': 'Americas', 'NCL': 'Oceania',
        'PYF': 'Oceania', 'REU': 'Africa', 'MTQ': 'Americas',
        'GLP': 'Americas', 'GUF': 'Americas', 'MYT': 'Africa',
        'TTO': 'Americas', 'BHS': 'Americas', 'BRB': 'Americas',
        'LCA': 'Americas', 'VCT': 'Americas', 'GRD': 'Americas',
        'ATG': 'Americas', 'KNA': 'Americas', 'DMA': 'Americas',
        'SUR': 'Americas', 'GUY': 'Americas', 'BLZ': 'Americas',
        'FJI': 'Oceania', 'PNG': 'Oceania', 'SLB': 'Oceania',
        'VUT': 'Oceania', 'WSM': 'Oceania', 'TON': 'Oceania',
        'FSM': 'Oceania', 'KIR': 'Oceania', 'MHL': 'Oceania',
        'PLW': 'Oceania', 'NRU': 'Oceania', 'TUV': 'Oceania',
        'COK': 'Oceania', 'NIU': 'Oceania',
        'BMU': 'Americas', 'CYM': 'Americas', 'AIA': 'Americas',
        'MSR': 'Americas', 'TCA': 'Americas', 'VGB': 'Americas',
        'GIB': 'Europe', 'GGY': 'Europe', 'JEY': 'Europe',
        'IMN': 'Europe', 'FRO': 'Europe', 'GRL': 'Americas',
        'ESH': 'Africa', 'SSD': 'Africa', 'TLS': 'Asia',
        'XKX': 'Europe', 'MNE': 'Europe', 'SRB': 'Europe',
        'BIH': 'Europe', 'MKD': 'Europe', 'MDA': 'Europe',
        'BLR': 'Europe', 'UKR': 'Europe', 'RUS': 'Europe',
    }

    broad_regions = {}
    for country in pycountry.countries:
        try:
            broad_regions[country.alpha_3] = _get_broad_region(country.alpha_3)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
    broad_regions.update(overrides)

    # Verify common ones
    for iso3, region in broad_regions.items():
        if region not in ['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania', 'Unknown']:
            broad_regions[iso3] = 'Unknown'

    return broad_regions

REGION_MAP = build_region_map()

REGION_COLORS = {
    'Africa': '#E85D3F',
    'Americas': '#3A7CA5',
    'Asia': '#2D9B8C',
    'Europe': '#D4A843',
    'Oceania': '#8B5CF6',
    'Unknown': '#9CA3AF',
}

# ─── Data Loading & Preparation ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_data():
    """Load and prepare the dataset."""
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
    df['region'] = df['iso_code'].map(REGION_MAP).fillna('Unknown')
    # UK note: data covers England & Wales only (preserve as-is from source)
    return df

# ─── KPI Computation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def compute_kpis(df):
    """Compute all required KPIs."""
    kpis = {}

    overall = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

    # 1. Global Median Homicide Rate (most recent year with sufficient data)
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent_data = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year]
    kpis['global_median_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].median(), 2)
    kpis['global_mean_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].mean(), 2)
    kpis['most_recent_year'] = int(recent_year)

    # 2. Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio
    male_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'male') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    female_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    # Most recent year with both male and female data
    common_years = set(male_data['year'].unique()) & set(female_data['year'].unique())
    latest_common = max(common_years)
    m_recent = male_data[male_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    f_recent = female_data[female_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    if f_recent > 0:
        kpis['male_female_ratio'] = round(m_recent / f_recent, 1)
    else:
        kpis['male_female_ratio'] = None
    kpis['male_female_ratio_year'] = int(latest_common)

    # 3. Highest National Homicide Rate (most recent year)
    kpis['highest_national_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].max(), 2)
    highest_country = recent_data.loc[recent_data['homicide_rate'].idxmax(), 'country']
    kpis['highest_national_country'] = highest_country

    # 4. Decade-over-Decade Change
    decades = {
        '1990s': (1990, 1999),
        '2000s': (2000, 2009),
        '2010s': (2010, 2019),
        '2020s': (2020, 2023),
    }
    decade_avgs = {}
    for label, (start, end) in decades.items():
        period = overall[(overall['year'] >= start) & (overall['year'] <= end)]
        if len(period) > 0:
            decade_avgs[label] = period.groupby('year')['homicide_rate'].mean().mean()
        else:
            decade_avgs[label] = np.nan
    kpis['decade_avgs'] = decade_avgs

    # 5. Reporting Coverage Rate
    year_coverage = {}
    all_years = sorted(overall['year'].unique())
    total_countries = df['iso_code'].nunique()
    for y in all_years:
        n_reporting = overall[overall['year'] == y]['iso_code'].nunique()
        year_coverage[int(y)] = round(n_reporting / total_countries * 100, 1)
    kpis['year_coverage'] = year_coverage
    kpis['total_countries'] = total_countries

    return kpis, overall

# ─── Chart Generation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def fig_to_b64(fig):
    """Convert matplotlib figure to base64 PNG string."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    buf.seek(0)
    b64 = base64.b64encode(buf.read()).decode('utf-8')
    plt.close(fig)
    return f'data:image/png;base64,{b64}'

def chart_global_trend(overall, kpis):
    """Line chart: global mean & median homicide rate over time with reporting countries."""
    yearly = overall.groupby('year').agg(
        mean_rate=('homicide_rate', 'mean'),
        median_rate=('homicide_rate', 'median'),
        n_countries=('iso_code', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

    color_mean = PALETTE['accent']
    color_median = PALETTE['blue']
    color_countries = PALETTE['gray']

    ax1.plot(yearly['year'], yearly['mean_rate'], color=color_mean, linewidth=2,
             label='Global Mean Rate', marker='o', markersize=3)
    ax1.plot(yearly['year'], yearly['median_rate'], color=color_median, linewidth=2,
             label='Global Median Rate', marker='s', markersize=3)
    ax1.fill_between(yearly['year'], yearly['median_rate'], yearly['mean_rate'],
                      alpha=0.1, color=color_mean)
    ax1.set_ylabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)', color=PALETTE['dark'])
    ax1.set_xlabel('Year')

    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.bar(yearly['year'], yearly['n_countries'], alpha=0.25, color=color_countries,
            label='Reporting Countries')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Reporting Countries', color=color_gray)
    ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_gray)

    lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
    lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
    ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper right', frameon=True)

    ax1.set_title('Global Intentional Homicide Rate Trends (1990–2023)', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_regional_trends(overall):
    """Multi-line chart: mean homicide rate by region over time."""
    regional = overall.groupby(['year', 'region'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
    for region in ['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']:
        rdata = regional[regional['region'] == region]
        if len(rdata) > 5:
            ax.plot(rdata['year'], rdata['homicide_rate'],
                    color=REGION_COLORS[region], linewidth=2, label=region, marker='.', markersize=2)

    ax.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax.set_ylabel('Mean Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title('Regional Homicide Rate Trends', fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_top10_bottom10(overall):
    """Horizontal bar chart: top 10 and bottom 10 countries by most recent rate."""
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year].copy()

    # Top 10 highest
    top10 = recent.nlargest(10, 'homicide_rate')[['country', 'homicide_rate']].sort_values('homicide_rate')
    # Bottom 10 lowest (with data)
    bottom10 = recent.nsmallest(10, 'homicide_rate')[['country', 'homicide_rate']].sort_values('homicide_rate', ascending=False)

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    colors_top = [PALETTE['danger'] if i >= len(top10) - 1 else PALETTE['accent'] for i in range(len(top10))]
    ax1.barh(range(len(top10)), top10['homicide_rate'], color=colors_top, edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top10)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(top10['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('Rate per 100,000')
    ax1.set_title(f'Highest Rates ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    for i, v in enumerate(top10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax1.text(v + 0.3, i, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=7)

    colors_bot = [PALETTE['teal'] if i == 0 else PALETTE['success'] for i in range(len(bottom10))]
    ax2.barh(range(len(bottom10)), bottom10['homicide_rate'], color=colors_bot, edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(bottom10)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(bottom10['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('Rate per 100,000')
    ax2.set_title(f'Lowest Rates ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    for i, v in enumerate(bottom10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 0.02, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_sex_disparity(df):
    """Chart showing male vs female homicide rates over time."""
    sex_data = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    yearly = sex_data.groupby(['year', 'sex'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    # Left: male vs female trend
    for sex, color, marker in [('male', PALETTE['blue'], 'o'), ('female', PALETTE['accent'], 's')]:
        sdata = yearly[yearly['sex'] == sex]
        ax1.plot(sdata['year'], sdata['homicide_rate'], color=color, linewidth=2,
                 label=sex.capitalize(), marker=marker, markersize=3)

    ax1.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax1.set_ylabel('Mean Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax1.set_title('Male vs. Female Homicide Rates Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.legend()
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # Right: male-to-female ratio over time
    pivot = yearly.pivot(index='year', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate')
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['ratio'])

    ax2.fill_between(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], alpha=0.2, color=PALETTE['gold'])
    ax2.plot(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], color=PALETTE['gold'], linewidth=2.5, marker='D', markersize=3)
    ax2.axhline(y=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Parity (1:1)')
    ax2.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Male-to-Female Ratio')
    ax2.set_title('Gender Disparity Ratio Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax2.legend()
    ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_sex_disparity_by_country(df):
    """Chart: Male-to-female ratio for selected countries (most recent year)."""
    recent = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    recent_year = recent['year'].max()
    recent = recent[recent['year'] == recent_year]

    pivot = recent.pivot_table(index='country', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate', aggfunc='mean')
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['male', 'female'])
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot[pivot['ratio'].notna() & (pivot['ratio'] > 0)]

    # Top 15 countries by ratio
    top15 = pivot.nlargest(15, 'ratio').sort_values('ratio')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    colors = [PALETTE['accent'] if r > 15 else PALETTE['gold'] for r in top15['ratio']]
    ax.barh(range(len(top15)), top15['ratio'], color=colors, edgecolor='white')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(top15)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(top15.index.values, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio')
    ax.set_title(f'Gender Disparity by Country ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    ax.axvline(x=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

    for i, v in enumerate(top15['ratio'].values):
        ax.text(v + 0.3, i, f'{v:.1f}x', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_age_group_analysis(df):
    """Chart: homicide rates by age group."""
    age_data = df[(df['age_group'] != 'ALL') & (df['sex'] == 'both')].copy()

def chart_age_heatmap(df):
    """Heatmap: age group rates by region."""
    age_data = df[(df['age_group'] != 'ALL') & (df['sex'] == 'both')].copy()
    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']

    pivot = age_data.groupby(['region', 'age_group'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()
    heatmap = pivot.pivot(index='region', columns='age_group', values='homicide_rate')

    # Reorder columns and rows
    available_cols = [c for c in age_order if c in heatmap.columns]
    heatmap = heatmap[available_cols]
    heatmap = heatmap.reindex(['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']).dropna(how='all')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
    im = ax.imshow(heatmap.values, aspect='auto', cmap='YlOrRd')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(available_cols)))
    ax.set_xticklabels([age_labels[age_order.index(c)] if c in age_order else c for c in available_cols],
                       fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap.index)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap.index, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Mean Homicide Rate by Age Group and Region', fontweight='bold')

    for i in range(len(heatmap.index)):
        for j in range(len(available_cols)):
            val = heatmap.iloc[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                ax.text(j, i, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
                        color='white' if val > 10 else 'black')

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    cbar.set_label('Rate per 100,000')

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_notable_changes(overall):
    """Chart: Countries with largest increases and decreases in homicide rates."""
    # Find countries with at least 15 years of data and compare first vs last 5-year average
    country_counts = overall.groupby('iso_code')['year'].nunique()
    valid_countries = country_counts[country_counts >= 10].index

    changes = []
    for iso in valid_countries:
        cdata = overall[(overall['iso_code'] == iso)].sort_values('year')
        if len(cdata) < 10:
            continue
        early = cdata[cdata['year'] <= cdata['year'].min() + 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        late = cdata[cdata['year'] >= cdata['year'].max() - 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        if early > 0:
            pct_change = ((late - early) / early) * 100
            abs_change = late - early
            changes.append({
                'country': cdata['country'].iloc[0],
                'iso_code': iso,
                'early_rate': early,
                'late_rate': late,
                'pct_change': pct_change,
                'abs_change': abs_change,
            })

    changes_df = pd.DataFrame(changes).dropna()

    # Top 10 improvers (biggest decrease)
    improvers = changes_df.nsmallest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change', ascending=False)
    # Top 10 deteriorators (biggest increase)
    deteriorators = changes_df.nlargest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change')

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    ax1.barh(range(len(improvers)), improvers['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['success'], edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(improvers)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(improvers['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax1.set_title('Largest Decreases (Improvements)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['success'])
    for i, v in enumerate(improvers['pct_change'].values):
        ax1.text(v - 2, i, f'{v:.0f}%', va='center', ha='right', fontsize=7, color='white')

    ax2.barh(range(len(deteriorators)), deteriorators['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['danger'], edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(deteriorators)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(deteriorators['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax2.set_title('Largest Increases (Deteriorations)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['danger'])
    for i, v in enumerate(deteriorators['pct_change'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 2, i, f'+{v:.0f}%', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig), deteriorators, improvers

        <li><strong>Target Young Adult Males for Prevention:</strong> The data consistently show that males aged 20–29 face the highest homicide risk globally. Prevention programs — including youth employment initiatives, conflict-resolution training, and community-based violence interruption — should prioritize this demographic, particularly in high-burden regions like Africa and the Americas.</li>
        <li><strong>Invest in Data Infrastructure:</strong> The reporting gaps visible in this dataset hinder effective monitoring and response. International donors and multilateral organizations should invest in strengthening national statistical systems, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa where reporting is most inconsistent.</li>
        <li><strong>Address Regional Hotspots with Tailored Strategies:</strong> One-size-fits-all approaches are unlikely to succeed given the vast heterogeneity observed. Regional bodies (e.g., African Union, OAS) should develop context-specific violence reduction frameworks informed by local homicide patterns.</li>
        <li><strong>Monitor Gender Disparity Trends:</strong> The male-to-female homicide ratio is not narrowing over time. Policy evaluations should examine whether existing violence-prevention programs differentially reach men versus women, and whether gender-sensitive interventions could improve outcomes.</li>
        <li><strong>Focus on Countries Moving Against the Global Trend:</strong> While the global trajectory is encouraging, several countries have seen significant deteriorations. International cooperation should prioritize technical assistance and resource allocation to countries where homicide rates are rising rapidly.</li>
        <li><strong>Strengthen Age-Disaggregated Data Collection:</strong> Age-specific analysis reveals critical patterns — particularly elevated risk among adolescents and young adults — but gaps in age-disaggregated reporting limit the ability to design targeted interventions. Standardizing age-group reporting categories across countries would enhance comparability.</li>
    </ol>
</section>

</html>"""

    return html

# ─── Main ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def main():

    df = load_data()
    print(f"  {len(df):,} rows, {df['iso_code'].nunique()} countries, {df['year'].min()}-{df['year'].max()}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Intentional Homicide Trends Report Generator (1990-2023)
Generates a self-contained HTML report with embedded charts from UNODC data.
"""

import base64
import io
import json
import os
import textwrap
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pycountry

# ─── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DATA_PATH = '/app/benchmark/data.csv'
OUTPUT_PATH = '/app/output/final_report.html'
TASK_INPUT_PATH = '/app/benchmark/task_input.json'

# Color palette — professional, accessible
PALETTE = {
    'primary': '#1B2A4A',       # dark navy
    'accent': '#E85D3F',        # warm red-orange
    'blue': '#3A7CA5',
    'teal': '#2D9B8C',
    'gold': '#D4A843',
    'gray': '#6B7280',
    'light_bg': '#F8F9FA',
    'white': '#FFFFFF',
    'dark': '#1F2937',
    'danger': '#DC2626',
    'success': '#16A34A',
    'warning': '#F59E0B',
}

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Sans'
plt.rcParams['axes.titlesize'] = 12
plt.rcParams['axes.labelsize'] = 10

# ─── Region Mapping ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_region_map():
    """Map ISO alpha-3 codes to UN regions."""
    region_map = {}
    for country in pycountry.countries:
        try:
            iso3 = country.alpha_3
            region_map[iso3] = getattr(country, 'region', 'Unknown')
            if hasattr(country, 'subregion'):
                region_map[f"{iso3}_sub"] = country.subregion
        except AttributeError:
            pass

    # Subregion to broad region mapping
    subregion_to_broad = {
        'Northern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Western Europe': 'Europe',
        'Southern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Eastern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Western Asia': 'Asia',
        'Central Asia': 'Asia',
        'Eastern Asia': 'Asia',
        'Southern Asia': 'Asia',
        'South-eastern Asia': 'Asia',
        'Northern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Western Africa': 'Africa',
        'Middle Africa': 'Africa',
        'Eastern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Southern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Northern America': 'Americas',
        'Central America': 'Americas',
        'South America': 'Americas',
        'Caribbean': 'Americas',
        'Australia and New Zealand': 'Oceania',
        'Melanesia': 'Oceania',
        'Micronesia': 'Oceania',
        'Polynesia': 'Oceania',
    }

    def _get_broad_region(iso3):
        """Get broad region for an ISO alpha-3 code."""
        sub = region_map.get(f"{iso3}_sub", None)
        if sub and sub in subregion_to_broad:
            return subregion_to_broad[sub]
        reg = region_map.get(iso3, None)
        if reg and reg in subregion_to_broad:
            return subregion_to_broad[reg]
        return region_map.get(iso3, 'Unknown')

    # Manual overrides for territories and special cases
    overrides = {
        'HKG': 'Asia', 'MAC': 'Asia', 'TWN': 'Asia',
        'PRI': 'Americas', 'GUM': 'Oceania', 'VIR': 'Americas',
        'CUW': 'Americas', 'ABW': 'Americas', 'NCL': 'Oceania',
        'PYF': 'Oceania', 'REU': 'Africa', 'MTQ': 'Americas',
        'GLP': 'Americas', 'GUF': 'Americas', 'MYT': 'Africa',
        'TTO': 'Americas', 'BHS': 'Americas', 'BRB': 'Americas',
        'LCA': 'Americas', 'VCT': 'Americas', 'GRD': 'Americas',
        'ATG': 'Americas', 'KNA': 'Americas', 'DMA': 'Americas',
        'SUR': 'Americas', 'GUY': 'Americas', 'BLZ': 'Americas',
        'FJI': 'Oceania', 'PNG': 'Oceania', 'SLB': 'Oceania',
        'VUT': 'Oceania', 'WSM': 'Oceania', 'TON': 'Oceania',
        'FSM': 'Oceania', 'KIR': 'Oceania', 'MHL': 'Oceania',
        'PLW': 'Oceania', 'NRU': 'Oceania', 'TUV': 'Oceania',
        'COK': 'Oceania', 'NIU': 'Oceania',
        'BMU': 'Americas', 'CYM': 'Americas', 'AIA': 'Americas',
        'MSR': 'Americas', 'TCA': 'Americas', 'VGB': 'Americas',
        'GIB': 'Europe', 'GGY': 'Europe', 'JEY': 'Europe',
        'IMN': 'Europe', 'FRO': 'Europe', 'GRL': 'Americas',
        'ESH': 'Africa', 'SSD': 'Africa', 'TLS': 'Asia',
        'XKX': 'Europe', 'MNE': 'Europe', 'SRB': 'Europe',
        'BIH': 'Europe', 'MKD': 'Europe', 'MDA': 'Europe',
        'BLR': 'Europe', 'UKR': 'Europe', 'RUS': 'Europe',
    }

    broad_regions = {}
    for country in pycountry.countries:
        try:
            broad_regions[country.alpha_3] = _get_broad_region(country.alpha_3)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
    broad_regions.update(overrides)

    # Verify common ones
    for iso3, region in broad_regions.items():
        if region not in ['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania', 'Unknown']:
            broad_regions[iso3] = 'Unknown'

    return broad_regions

REGION_MAP = build_region_map()

REGION_COLORS = {
    'Africa': '#E85D3F',
    'Americas': '#3A7CA5',
    'Asia': '#2D9B8C',
    'Europe': '#D4A843',
    'Oceania': '#8B5CF6',
    'Unknown': '#9CA3AF',
}

# ─── Data Loading & Preparation ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_data():
    """Load and prepare the dataset."""
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
    df['region'] = df['iso_code'].map(REGION_MAP).fillna('Unknown')
    # UK note: data covers England & Wales only (preserve as-is from source)
    return df

# ─── KPI Computation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def compute_kpis(df):
    """Compute all required KPIs."""
    kpis = {}

    overall = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

    # 1. Global Median Homicide Rate (most recent year with sufficient data)
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent_data = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year]
    kpis['global_median_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].median(), 2)
    kpis['global_mean_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].mean(), 2)
    kpis['most_recent_year'] = int(recent_year)

    # 2. Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio
    male_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'male') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    female_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    # Most recent year with both male and female data
    common_years = set(male_data['year'].unique()) & set(female_data['year'].unique())
    latest_common = max(common_years)
    m_recent = male_data[male_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    f_recent = female_data[female_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    if f_recent > 0:
        kpis['male_female_ratio'] = round(m_recent / f_recent, 1)
    else:
        kpis['male_female_ratio'] = None
    kpis['male_female_ratio_year'] = int(latest_common)

    # 3. Highest National Homicide Rate (most recent year)
    kpis['highest_national_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].max(), 2)
    highest_country = recent_data.loc[recent_data['homicide_rate'].idxmax(), 'country']
    kpis['highest_national_country'] = highest_country

    # 4. Decade-over-Decade Change
    decades = {
        '1990s': (1990, 1999),
        '2000s': (2000, 2009),
        '2010s': (2010, 2019),
        '2020s': (2020, 2023),
    }
    decade_avgs = {}
    for label, (start, end) in decades.items():
        period = overall[(overall['year'] >= start) & (overall['year'] <= end)]
        if len(period) > 0:
            decade_avgs[label] = period.groupby('year')['homicide_rate'].mean().mean()
        else:
            decade_avgs[label] = np.nan
    kpis['decade_avgs'] = decade_avgs

    # 5. Reporting Coverage Rate
    year_coverage = {}
    all_years = sorted(overall['year'].unique())
    total_countries = df['iso_code'].nunique()
    for y in all_years:
        n_reporting = overall[overall['year'] == y]['iso_code'].nunique()
        year_coverage[int(y)] = round(n_reporting / total_countries * 100, 1)
    kpis['year_coverage'] = year_coverage
    kpis['total_countries'] = total_countries

    return kpis, overall

# ─── Chart Generation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def fig_to_b64(fig):
    """Convert matplotlib figure to base64 PNG string."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    buf.seek(0)
    b64 = base64.b64encode(buf.read()).decode('utf-8')
    plt.close(fig)
    return f'data:image/png;base64,{b64}'

def chart_global_trend(overall, kpis):
    """Line chart: global mean & median homicide rate over time with reporting countries."""
    yearly = overall.groupby('year').agg(
        mean_rate=('homicide_rate', 'mean'),
        median_rate=('homicide_rate', 'median'),
        n_countries=('iso_code', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

    color_mean = PALETTE['accent']
    color_median = PALETTE['blue']
    color_countries = PALETTE['gray']

    ax1.plot(yearly['year'], yearly['mean_rate'], color=color_mean, linewidth=2,
             label='Global Mean Rate', marker='o', markersize=3)
    ax1.plot(yearly['year'], yearly['median_rate'], color=color_median, linewidth=2,
             label='Global Median Rate', marker='s', markersize=3)
    ax1.fill_between(yearly['year'], yearly['median_rate'], yearly['mean_rate'],
                      alpha=0.1, color=color_mean)
    ax1.set_ylabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)', color=PALETTE['dark'])
    ax1.set_xlabel('Year')

    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.bar(yearly['year'], yearly['n_countries'], alpha=0.25, color=color_countries,
            label='Reporting Countries')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Reporting Countries', color=color_gray)
    ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_gray)

    lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
    lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
    ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper right', frameon=True)

    ax1.set_title('Global Intentional Homicide Rate Trends (1990–2023)', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_regional_trends(overall):
    """Multi-line chart: mean homicide rate by region over time."""
    regional = overall.groupby(['year', 'region'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
    for region in ['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']:
        rdata = regional[regional['region'] == region]
        if len(rdata) > 5:
            ax.plot(rdata['year'], rdata['homicide_rate'],
                    color=REGION_COLORS[region], linewidth=2, label=region, marker='.', markersize=2)

    ax.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax.set_ylabel('Mean Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title('Regional Homicide Rate Trends', fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_top10_bottom10(overall):
    """Horizontal bar chart: top 10 and bottom 10 countries by most recent rate."""
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year].copy()

    # Top 10 highest
    top10 = recent.nlargest(10, 'homicide_rate')[['country', 'homicide_rate']].sort_values('homicide_rate')
    # Bottom 10 lowest (with data)
    bottom10 = recent.nsmallest(10, 'homicide_rate')[['country', 'homicide_rate']].sort_values('homicide_rate', ascending=False)

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    colors_top = [PALETTE['danger'] if i >= len(top10) - 1 else PALETTE['accent'] for i in range(len(top10))]
    ax1.barh(range(len(top10)), top10['homicide_rate'], color=colors_top, edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top10)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(top10['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('Rate per 100,000')
    ax1.set_title(f'Highest Rates ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    for i, v in enumerate(top10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax1.text(v + 0.3, i, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=7)

    colors_bot = [PALETTE['teal'] if i == 0 else PALETTE['success'] for i in range(len(bottom10))]
    ax2.barh(range(len(bottom10)), bottom10['homicide_rate'], color=colors_bot, edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(bottom10)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(bottom10['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('Rate per 100,000')
    ax2.set_title(f'Lowest Rates ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    for i, v in enumerate(bottom10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 0.02, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_sex_disparity(df):
    """Chart showing male vs female homicide rates over time."""
    sex_data = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    yearly = sex_data.groupby(['year', 'sex'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    # Left: male vs female trend
    for sex, color, marker in [('male', PALETTE['blue'], 'o'), ('female', PALETTE['accent'], 's')]:
        sdata = yearly[yearly['sex'] == sex]
        ax1.plot(sdata['year'], sdata['homicide_rate'], color=color, linewidth=2,
                 label=sex.capitalize(), marker=marker, markersize=3)

    ax1.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax1.set_ylabel('Mean Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax1.set_title('Male vs. Female Homicide Rates Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.legend()
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # Right: male-to-female ratio over time
    pivot = yearly.pivot(index='year', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate')
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['ratio'])

    ax2.fill_between(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], alpha=0.2, color=PALETTE['gold'])
    ax2.plot(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], color=PALETTE['gold'], linewidth=2.5, marker='D', markersize=3)
    ax2.axhline(y=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Parity (1:1)')
    ax2.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Male-to-Female Ratio')
    ax2.set_title('Gender Disparity Ratio Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax2.legend()
    ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_sex_disparity_by_country(df):
    """Chart: Male-to-female ratio for selected countries (most recent year)."""
    recent = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    recent_year = recent['year'].max()
    recent = recent[recent['year'] == recent_year]

    pivot = recent.pivot_table(index='country', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate', aggfunc='mean')
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['male', 'female'])
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot[pivot['ratio'].notna() & (pivot['ratio'] > 0)]

    # Top 15 countries by ratio
    top15 = pivot.nlargest(15, 'ratio').sort_values('ratio')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    colors = [PALETTE['accent'] if r > 15 else PALETTE['gold'] for r in top15['ratio']]
    ax.barh(range(len(top15)), top15['ratio'], color=colors, edgecolor='white')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(top15)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(top15.index.values, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio')
    ax.set_title(f'Gender Disparity by Country ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    ax.axvline(x=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

    for i, v in enumerate(top15['ratio'].values):
        ax.text(v + 0.3, i, f'{v:.1f}x', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_age_group_analysis(df):
    """Chart: homicide rates by age group."""
    age_data = df[(df['age_group'] != 'ALL') & (df['sex'] == 'both')].copy()

    # Map age groups to ordered categories
    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']

    age_global = age_data.groupby('age_group')['homicide_rate'].agg(['mean', 'median']).reset_index()
    age_global['order'] = age_global['age_group'].apply(lambda x: age_order.index(x) if x in age_order else 99)
    age_global = age_global.sort_values('order')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.5))

    x = range(len(age_global))
    width = 0.35

    bars1 = ax.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], age_global['mean'], width,
                   color=PALETTE['blue'], alpha=0.8, label='Mean Rate', edgecolor='white')
    bars2 = ax.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], age_global['median'], width,
                   color=PALETTE['accent'], alpha=0.8, label='Median Rate', edgecolor='white')

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([age_labels[age_order.index(ag)] if ag in age_order else ag
                        for ag in age_global['age_group'].values], fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title('Global Homicide Rate by Age Group', fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, axis='y')

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_age_heatmap(df):
    """Heatmap: age group rates by region."""
    age_data = df[(df['age_group'] != 'ALL') & (df['sex'] == 'both')].copy()
    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']

    pivot = age_data.groupby(['region', 'age_group'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()
    heatmap = pivot.pivot(index='region', columns='age_group', values='homicide_rate')

    # Reorder columns and rows
    available_cols = [c for c in age_order if c in heatmap.columns]
    heatmap = heatmap[available_cols]
    heatmap = heatmap.reindex(['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']).dropna(how='all')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
    im = ax.imshow(heatmap.values, aspect='auto', cmap='YlOrRd')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(available_cols)))
    ax.set_xticklabels([age_labels[age_order.index(c)] if c in age_order else c for c in available_cols],
                       fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap.index)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap.index, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Mean Homicide Rate by Age Group and Region', fontweight='bold')

    for i in range(len(heatmap.index)):
        for j in range(len(available_cols)):
            val = heatmap.iloc[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                ax.text(j, i, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
                        color='white' if val > 10 else 'black')

def chart_notable_changes(overall):
    """Chart: Countries with largest increases and decreases in homicide rates."""
    # Find countries with at least 15 years of data and compare first vs last 5-year average
    country_counts = overall.groupby('iso_code')['year'].nunique()
    valid_countries = country_counts[country_counts >= 10].index

    changes = []
    for iso in valid_countries:
        cdata = overall[(overall['iso_code'] == iso)].sort_values('year')
        if len(cdata) < 10:
            continue
        early = cdata[cdata['year'] <= cdata['year'].min() + 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        late = cdata[cdata['year'] >= cdata['year'].max() - 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        if early > 0:
            pct_change = ((late - early) / early) * 100
            abs_change = late - early
            changes.append({
                'country': cdata['country'].iloc[0],
                'iso_code': iso,
                'early_rate': early,
                'late_rate': late,
                'pct_change': pct_change,
                'abs_change': abs_change,
            })

    changes_df = pd.DataFrame(changes).dropna()

    # Top 10 improvers (biggest decrease)
    improvers = changes_df.nsmallest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change', ascending=False)
    # Top 10 deteriorators (biggest increase)
    deteriorators = changes_df.nlargest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change')

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    ax1.barh(range(len(improvers)), improvers['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['success'], edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(improvers)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(improvers['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax1.set_title('Largest Decreases (Improvements)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['success'])
    for i, v in enumerate(improvers['pct_change'].values):
        ax1.text(v - 2, i, f'{v:.0f}%', va='center', ha='right', fontsize=7, color='white')

    ax2.barh(range(len(deteriorators)), deteriorators['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['danger'], edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(deteriorators)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(deteriorators['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax2.set_title('Largest Increases (Deteriorations)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['danger'])
    for i, v in enumerate(deteriorators['pct_change'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 2, i, f'+{v:.0f}%', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig), deteriorators, improvers

def chart_coverage(kpis):
    """Chart: Reporting coverage over time."""
    years = list(kpis['year_coverage'].keys())
    coverage = list(kpis['year_coverage'].values())

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
    ax.fill_between(years, coverage, alpha=0.3, color=PALETTE['blue'])
    ax.plot(years, coverage, color=PALETTE['blue'], linewidth=2, marker='.', markersize=4)
    ax.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax.set_ylabel('% of Countries Reporting')
    ax.set_title('UNODC Reporting Coverage Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_ylim(0, 100)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FormatStrFormatter('%.0f%%'))

    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_regional_boxplot(overall):
    """Box plot of homicide rates by region for the most recent year."""
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.5))
    regions = ['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']
    data_by_region = [recent[recent['region'] == r]['homicide_rate'].dropna().values for r in regions]

    bp = ax.boxplot(data_by_region, labels=regions, patch_artist=True)
    for patch, region in zip(bp['boxes'], regions):
        patch.set_facecolor(REGION_COLORS[region])
        patch.set_alpha(0.7)

    ax.set_ylabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title(f'Distribution of National Homicide Rates by Region ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, axis='y')

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, 'w') as f:
        f.write(html)

    size_kb = os.path.getsize(OUTPUT_PATH) / 1024
    print(f"\nReport saved to: {OUTPUT_PATH} ({size_kb:.0f} KB)")
    print("Done.")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Intentional Homicide Trends Report Generator (1990-2023)
Generates a self-contained HTML report with embedded charts from UNODC data.
"""

import base64
import io
import json
import os
import textwrap
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import pycountry

# ─── Configuration ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

DATA_PATH = '/app/benchmark/data.csv'
OUTPUT_PATH = '/app/output/final_report.html'
TASK_INPUT_PATH = '/app/benchmark/task_input.json'

# Color palette — professional, accessible
PALETTE = {
    'primary': '#1B2A4A',       # dark navy
    'accent': '#E85D3F',        # warm red-orange
    'blue': '#3A7CA5',
    'teal': '#2D9B8C',
    'gold': '#D4A843',
    'gray': '#6B7280',
    'light_bg': '#F8F9FA',
    'white': '#FFFFFF',
    'dark': '#1F2937',
    'danger': '#DC2626',
    'success': '#16A34A',
    'warning': '#F59E0B',
}

plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'DejaVu Sans'
plt.rcParams['axes.titlesize'] = 12
plt.rcParams['axes.labelsize'] = 10

# ─── Region Mapping ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def build_region_map():
    """Map ISO alpha-3 codes to UN regions."""
    region_map = {}
    for country in pycountry.countries:
        try:
            iso3 = country.alpha_3
            region_map[iso3] = getattr(country, 'region', 'Unknown')
            if hasattr(country, 'subregion'):
                region_map[f"{iso3}_sub"] = country.subregion
        except AttributeError:
            pass

    # Subregion to broad region mapping
    subregion_to_broad = {
        'Northern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Western Europe': 'Europe',
        'Southern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Eastern Europe': 'Europe',
        'Western Asia': 'Asia',
        'Central Asia': 'Asia',
        'Eastern Asia': 'Asia',
        'Southern Asia': 'Asia',
        'South-eastern Asia': 'Asia',
        'Northern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Western Africa': 'Africa',
        'Middle Africa': 'Africa',
        'Eastern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Southern Africa': 'Africa',
        'Northern America': 'Americas',
        'Central America': 'Americas',
        'South America': 'Americas',
        'Caribbean': 'Americas',
        'Australia and New Zealand': 'Oceania',
        'Melanesia': 'Oceania',
        'Micronesia': 'Oceania',
        'Polynesia': 'Oceania',
    }

    def _get_broad_region(iso3):
        """Get broad region for an ISO alpha-3 code."""
        sub = region_map.get(f"{iso3}_sub", None)
        if sub and sub in subregion_to_broad:
            return subregion_to_broad[sub]
        reg = region_map.get(iso3, None)
        if reg and reg in subregion_to_broad:
            return subregion_to_broad[reg]
        return region_map.get(iso3, 'Unknown')

    # Manual overrides for territories and special cases
    overrides = {
        'HKG': 'Asia', 'MAC': 'Asia', 'TWN': 'Asia',
        'PRI': 'Americas', 'GUM': 'Oceania', 'VIR': 'Americas',
        'CUW': 'Americas', 'ABW': 'Americas', 'NCL': 'Oceania',
        'PYF': 'Oceania', 'REU': 'Africa', 'MTQ': 'Americas',
        'GLP': 'Americas', 'GUF': 'Americas', 'MYT': 'Africa',
        'TTO': 'Americas', 'BHS': 'Americas', 'BRB': 'Americas',
        'LCA': 'Americas', 'VCT': 'Americas', 'GRD': 'Americas',
        'ATG': 'Americas', 'KNA': 'Americas', 'DMA': 'Americas',
        'SUR': 'Americas', 'GUY': 'Americas', 'BLZ': 'Americas',
        'FJI': 'Oceania', 'PNG': 'Oceania', 'SLB': 'Oceania',
        'VUT': 'Oceania', 'WSM': 'Oceania', 'TON': 'Oceania',
        'FSM': 'Oceania', 'KIR': 'Oceania', 'MHL': 'Oceania',
        'PLW': 'Oceania', 'NRU': 'Oceania', 'TUV': 'Oceania',
        'COK': 'Oceania', 'NIU': 'Oceania',
        'BMU': 'Americas', 'CYM': 'Americas', 'AIA': 'Americas',
        'MSR': 'Americas', 'TCA': 'Americas', 'VGB': 'Americas',
        'GIB': 'Europe', 'GGY': 'Europe', 'JEY': 'Europe',
        'IMN': 'Europe', 'FRO': 'Europe', 'GRL': 'Americas',
        'ESH': 'Africa', 'SSD': 'Africa', 'TLS': 'Asia',
        'XKX': 'Europe', 'MNE': 'Europe', 'SRB': 'Europe',
        'BIH': 'Europe', 'MKD': 'Europe', 'MDA': 'Europe',
        'BLR': 'Europe', 'UKR': 'Europe', 'RUS': 'Europe',
    }

    broad_regions = {}
    for country in pycountry.countries:
        try:
            broad_regions[country.alpha_3] = _get_broad_region(country.alpha_3)
        except AttributeError:
            pass
    broad_regions.update(overrides)

    # Verify common ones
    for iso3, region in broad_regions.items():
        if region not in ['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania', 'Unknown']:
            broad_regions[iso3] = 'Unknown'

    return broad_regions

REGION_MAP = build_region_map()

REGION_COLORS = {
    'Africa': '#E85D3F',
    'Americas': '#3A7CA5',
    'Asia': '#2D9B8C',
    'Europe': '#D4A843',
    'Oceania': '#8B5CF6',
    'Unknown': '#9CA3AF',
}

# ─── Data Loading & Preparation ──────────────────────────────────────────────

def load_data():
    """Load and prepare the dataset."""
    df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)
    df['region'] = df['iso_code'].map(REGION_MAP).fillna('Unknown')
    # UK note: data covers England & Wales only (preserve as-is from source)
    return df

# ─── KPI Computation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def compute_kpis(df):
    """Compute all required KPIs."""
    kpis = {}

    overall = df[(df['sex'] == 'both') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]

    # 1. Global Median Homicide Rate (most recent year with sufficient data)
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent_data = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year]
    kpis['global_median_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].median(), 2)
    kpis['global_mean_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].mean(), 2)
    kpis['most_recent_year'] = int(recent_year)

    # 2. Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio
    male_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'male') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    female_data = df[(df['sex'] == 'female') & (df['age_group'] == 'ALL')]
    # Most recent year with both male and female data
    common_years = set(male_data['year'].unique()) & set(female_data['year'].unique())
    latest_common = max(common_years)
    m_recent = male_data[male_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    f_recent = female_data[female_data['year'] == latest_common]['homicide_rate'].median()
    if f_recent > 0:
        kpis['male_female_ratio'] = round(m_recent / f_recent, 1)
    else:
        kpis['male_female_ratio'] = None
    kpis['male_female_ratio_year'] = int(latest_common)

    # 3. Highest National Homicide Rate (most recent year)
    kpis['highest_national_rate'] = round(recent_data['homicide_rate'].max(), 2)
    highest_country = recent_data.loc[recent_data['homicide_rate'].idxmax(), 'country']
    kpis['highest_national_country'] = highest_country

    # 4. Decade-over-Decade Change
    decades = {
        '1990s': (1990, 1999),
        '2000s': (2000, 2009),
        '2010s': (2010, 2019),
        '2020s': (2020, 2023),
    }
    decade_avgs = {}
    for label, (start, end) in decades.items():
        period = overall[(overall['year'] >= start) & (overall['year'] <= end)]
        if len(period) > 0:
            decade_avgs[label] = period.groupby('year')['homicide_rate'].mean().mean()
        else:
            decade_avgs[label] = np.nan
    kpis['decade_avgs'] = decade_avgs

    # 5. Reporting Coverage Rate
    year_coverage = {}
    all_years = sorted(overall['year'].unique())
    total_countries = df['iso_code'].nunique()
    for y in all_years:
        n_reporting = overall[overall['year'] == y]['iso_code'].nunique()
        year_coverage[int(y)] = round(n_reporting / total_countries * 100, 1)
    kpis['year_coverage'] = year_coverage
    kpis['total_countries'] = total_countries

    return kpis, overall

# ─── Chart Generation ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def fig_to_b64(fig):
    """Convert matplotlib figure to base64 PNG string."""
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    buf.seek(0)
    b64 = base64.b64encode(buf.read()).decode('utf-8')
    plt.close(fig)
    return f'data:image/png;base64,{b64}'

def chart_global_trend(overall, kpis):
    """Line chart: global mean & median homicide rate over time with reporting countries."""
    yearly = overall.groupby('year').agg(
        mean_rate=('homicide_rate', 'mean'),
        median_rate=('homicide_rate', 'median'),
        n_countries=('iso_code', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()

    fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))

    color_mean = PALETTE['accent']
    color_median = PALETTE['blue']
    color_countries = PALETTE['gray']

    ax1.plot(yearly['year'], yearly['mean_rate'], color=color_mean, linewidth=2,
             label='Global Mean Rate', marker='o', markersize=3)
    ax1.plot(yearly['year'], yearly['median_rate'], color=color_median, linewidth=2,
             label='Global Median Rate', marker='s', markersize=3)
    ax1.fill_between(yearly['year'], yearly['median_rate'], yearly['mean_rate'],
                      alpha=0.1, color=color_mean)
    ax1.set_ylabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)', color=PALETTE['dark'])
    ax1.set_xlabel('Year')

    ax2 = ax1.twinx()
    ax2.bar(yearly['year'], yearly['n_countries'], alpha=0.25, color=color_countries,
            label='Reporting Countries')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Reporting Countries', color=color_gray)
    ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor=color_gray)

    lines1, labels1 = ax1.get_legend_handles_labels()
    lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
    ax1.legend(lines1 + lines2, labels1 + labels2, loc='upper right', frameon=True)

    ax1.set_title('Global Intentional Homicide Rate Trends (1990–2023)', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_regional_trends(overall):
    """Multi-line chart: mean homicide rate by region over time."""
    regional = overall.groupby(['year', 'region'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5))
    for region in ['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']:
        rdata = regional[regional['region'] == region]
        if len(rdata) > 5:
            ax.plot(rdata['year'], rdata['homicide_rate'],
                    color=REGION_COLORS[region], linewidth=2, label=region, marker='.', markersize=2)

    ax.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax.set_ylabel('Mean Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title('Regional Homicide Rate Trends', fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=True)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_top10_bottom10(overall):
    """Horizontal bar chart: top 10 and bottom 10 countries by most recent rate."""
    recent_year = overall['year'].max()
    recent = overall[overall['year'] == recent_year].copy()

    # Top 10 highest
    top10 = recent.nlargest(10, 'homicide_rate')[['country', 'homicide_rate']].sort_values('homicide_rate')
    # Bottom 10 lowest (with data)
    bottom10 = recent.nsmallest(10, 'homicide_rate')[['country', 'homicide_rate']].sort_values('homicide_rate', ascending=False)

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    colors_top = [PALETTE['danger'] if i >= len(top10) - 1 else PALETTE['accent'] for i in range(len(top10))]
    ax1.barh(range(len(top10)), top10['homicide_rate'], color=colors_top, edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(top10)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(top10['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('Rate per 100,000')
    ax1.set_title(f'Highest Rates ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    for i, v in enumerate(top10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax1.text(v + 0.3, i, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=7)

    colors_bot = [PALETTE['teal'] if i == 0 else PALETTE['success'] for i in range(len(bottom10))]
    ax2.barh(range(len(bottom10)), bottom10['homicide_rate'], color=colors_bot, edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(bottom10)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(bottom10['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('Rate per 100,000')
    ax2.set_title(f'Lowest Rates ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    for i, v in enumerate(bottom10['homicide_rate'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 0.02, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_sex_disparity(df):
    """Chart showing male vs female homicide rates over time."""
    sex_data = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    yearly = sex_data.groupby(['year', 'sex'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    # Left: male vs female trend
    for sex, color, marker in [('male', PALETTE['blue'], 'o'), ('female', PALETTE['accent'], 's')]:
        sdata = yearly[yearly['sex'] == sex]
        ax1.plot(sdata['year'], sdata['homicide_rate'], color=color, linewidth=2,
                 label=sex.capitalize(), marker=marker, markersize=3)

    ax1.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax1.set_ylabel('Mean Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax1.set_title('Male vs. Female Homicide Rates Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax1.legend()
    ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # Right: male-to-female ratio over time
    pivot = yearly.pivot(index='year', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate')
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['ratio'])

    ax2.fill_between(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], alpha=0.2, color=PALETTE['gold'])
    ax2.plot(pivot.index, pivot['ratio'], color=PALETTE['gold'], linewidth=2.5, marker='D', markersize=3)
    ax2.axhline(y=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5, label='Parity (1:1)')
    ax2.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Male-to-Female Ratio')
    ax2.set_title('Gender Disparity Ratio Over Time', fontweight='bold')
    ax2.legend()
    ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_sex_disparity_by_country(df):
    """Chart: Male-to-female ratio for selected countries (most recent year)."""
    recent = df[(df['age_group'] == 'ALL') & (df['sex'].isin(['male', 'female']))]
    recent_year = recent['year'].max()
    recent = recent[recent['year'] == recent_year]

    pivot = recent.pivot_table(index='country', columns='sex', values='homicide_rate', aggfunc='mean')
    pivot = pivot.dropna(subset=['male', 'female'])
    pivot['ratio'] = pivot['male'] / pivot['female']
    pivot = pivot[pivot['ratio'].notna() & (pivot['ratio'] > 0)]

    # Top 15 countries by ratio
    top15 = pivot.nlargest(15, 'ratio').sort_values('ratio')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    colors = [PALETTE['accent'] if r > 15 else PALETTE['gold'] for r in top15['ratio']]
    ax.barh(range(len(top15)), top15['ratio'], color=colors, edgecolor='white')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(top15)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(top15.index.values, fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('Male-to-Female Homicide Rate Ratio')
    ax.set_title(f'Gender Disparity by Country ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
    ax.axvline(x=1.0, color=PALETTE['gray'], linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

    for i, v in enumerate(top15['ratio'].values):
        ax.text(v + 0.3, i, f'{v:.1f}x', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_age_group_analysis(df):
    """Chart: homicide rates by age group."""
    age_data = df[(df['age_group'] != 'ALL') & (df['sex'] == 'both')].copy()

    # Map age groups to ordered categories
    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']

    age_global = age_data.groupby('age_group')['homicide_rate'].agg(['mean', 'median']).reset_index()
    age_global['order'] = age_global['age_group'].apply(lambda x: age_order.index(x) if x in age_order else 99)
    age_global = age_global.sort_values('order')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.5))

    x = range(len(age_global))
    width = 0.35

    bars1 = ax.bar([i - width/2 for i in x], age_global['mean'], width,
                   color=PALETTE['blue'], alpha=0.8, label='Mean Rate', edgecolor='white')
    bars2 = ax.bar([i + width/2 for i in x], age_global['median'], width,
                   color=PALETTE['accent'], alpha=0.8, label='Median Rate', edgecolor='white')

    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([age_labels[age_order.index(ag)] if ag in age_order else ag
                        for ag in age_global['age_group'].values], fontsize=8)
    ax.set_ylabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title('Global Homicide Rate by Age Group', fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend()
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.2, axis='y')

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_age_heatmap(df):
    """Heatmap: age group rates by region."""
    age_data = df[(df['age_group'] != 'ALL') & (df['sex'] == 'both')].copy()
    age_order = ['0_9', '10_14', '15_17', '18_19', '20_24', '25_29', '30_44', '45_59', '60_PLUS']
    age_labels = ['0-9', '10-14', '15-17', '18-19', '20-24', '25-29', '30-44', '45-59', '60+']

    pivot = age_data.groupby(['region', 'age_group'])['homicide_rate'].mean().reset_index()
    heatmap = pivot.pivot(index='region', columns='age_group', values='homicide_rate')

    # Reorder columns and rows
    available_cols = [c for c in age_order if c in heatmap.columns]
    heatmap = heatmap[available_cols]
    heatmap = heatmap.reindex(['Africa', 'Americas', 'Asia', 'Europe', 'Oceania']).dropna(how='all')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4))
    im = ax.imshow(heatmap.values, aspect='auto', cmap='YlOrRd')

    ax.set_xticks(range(len(available_cols)))
    ax.set_xticklabels([age_labels[age_order.index(c)] if c in age_order else c for c in available_cols],
                       fontsize=8)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(heatmap.index)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(heatmap.index, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Mean Homicide Rate by Age Group and Region', fontweight='bold')

    for i in range(len(heatmap.index)):
        for j in range(len(available_cols)):
            val = heatmap.iloc[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                ax.text(j, i, f'{val:.1f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7,
                        color='white' if val > 10 else 'black')

    cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax, shrink=0.8)
    cbar.set_label('Rate per 100,000')

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig)

def chart_notable_changes(overall):
    """Chart: Countries with largest increases and decreases in homicide rates."""
    # Find countries with at least 15 years of data and compare first vs last 5-year average
    country_counts = overall.groupby('iso_code')['year'].nunique()
    valid_countries = country_counts[country_counts >= 10].index

    changes = []
    for iso in valid_countries:
        cdata = overall[(overall['iso_code'] == iso)].sort_values('year')
        if len(cdata) < 10:
            continue
        early = cdata[cdata['year'] <= cdata['year'].min() + 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        late = cdata[cdata['year'] >= cdata['year'].max() - 4]['homicide_rate'].mean()
        if early > 0:
            pct_change = ((late - early) / early) * 100
            abs_change = late - early
            changes.append({
                'country': cdata['country'].iloc[0],
                'iso_code': iso,
                'early_rate': early,
                'late_rate': late,
                'pct_change': pct_change,
                'abs_change': abs_change,
            })

    changes_df = pd.DataFrame(changes).dropna()

    # Top 10 improvers (biggest decrease)
    improvers = changes_df.nsmallest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change', ascending=False)
    # Top 10 deteriorators (biggest increase)
    deteriorators = changes_df.nlargest(10, 'pct_change').sort_values('pct_change')

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4.5))

    ax1.barh(range(len(improvers)), improvers['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['success'], edgecolor='white')
    ax1.set_yticks(range(len(improvers)))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(improvers['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax1.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax1.set_title('Largest Decreases (Improvements)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['success'])
    for i, v in enumerate(improvers['pct_change'].values):
        ax1.text(v - 2, i, f'{v:.0f}%', va='center', ha='right', fontsize=7, color='white')

    ax2.barh(range(len(deteriorators)), deteriorators['pct_change'], color=PALETTE['danger'], edgecolor='white')
    ax2.set_yticks(range(len(deteriorators)))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(deteriorators['country'].values, fontsize=8)
    ax2.set_xlabel('% Change')
    ax2.set_title('Largest Increases (Deteriorations)', fontweight='bold', color=PALETTE['danger'])
    for i, v in enumerate(deteriorators['pct_change'].values):
        ax2.text(v + 2, i, f'+{v:.0f}%', va='center', fontsize=7)

    plt.tight_layout()
    return fig_to_b64(fig), deteriorators, improvers

def chart_coverage(kpis):
    """Chart: Reporting coverage over time."""
    years = list(kpis['year_coverage'].keys())
    coverage = list(kpis['year_coverage'].values())

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 3.5))
    ax.fill_between(years, coverage, alpha=0.3, color=PALETTE['blue'])
    ax.plot(years, coverage, color=PALETTE['blue'], linewidth=2, marker='.', markersize=4)
    ax.set_xlabel('Year')
    ax.set_ylabel('% of Countries Reporting')

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.5))

    data_by_region = [recent[recent['region'] == r]['homicide_rate'].dropna().values for r in regions]

    bp = ax.boxplot(data_by_region, labels=regions, patch_artist=True)
    for patch, region in zip(bp['boxes'], regions):
        patch.set_facecolor(REGION_COLORS[region])
        patch.set_alpha(0.7)

    ax.set_ylabel('Homicide Rate (per 100,000)')
    ax.set_title(f'Distribution of National Homicide Rates by Region ({int(recent_year)})', fontweight='bold')
